title: The IAM family: individual models side by side
summary: GCAM is one of several global IAMs. Compare it with MESSAGEix-GLOBIOM, REMIND-MAgPIE, IMAGE, AIM-Hub, WITCH and DICE: how each solves, what it sees, and how it treats transport.
outcomes: Classify an IAM by solution concept, foresight and economic scope
Explain how each of seven models solves, in one sentence each
Predict how model structure shapes results such as carbon price paths
Choose and justify a model or a model comparison for a research question
narration_en: GCAM is not the only integrated assessment model, and a good researcher knows its relatives. The models differ in three big choices. The first is foresight. GCAM, IMAGE and AIM-Hub are recursive: they solve one period at a time without knowing the future. MESSAGEix, REMIND and WITCH have perfect foresight: they choose every period at once. The second is how much of the economy they cover. GCAM and IMAGE are partial equilibrium models of energy and land markets, while AIM-Hub, REMIND and WITCH represent the whole economy. The third is how they solve. MESSAGEix minimises total system cost with a large linear programme. REMIND maximises welfare over the century. WITCH lets regions play a game against each other. IMAGE simulates land and the environment on a fine grid. DICE, the simplest, weighs the cost of cutting emissions against the damage avoided. These choices shape results. Foresight models tend to act early and smoothly, with carbon prices rising at the discount rate. Recursive models react period by period. In transport, REMIND's EDGE-T module is a fork of GCAM's transport model. Open the model atlas to explore each one.
narration_ar: ليس جي كام نموذج التقييم المتكامل الوحيد، والباحث الجيد يعرف أقرباءه. تختلف النماذج في ثلاثة خيارات كبرى. الأول هو الاستشراف. فنماذج جي كام وإيميج وإيم هب نماذج تتابعية: تحل فترة واحدة في كل مرة دون معرفة المستقبل. أما مسج وريمايند وويتش فلديها استشراف كامل: تختار جميع الفترات دفعة واحدة. والثاني هو مقدار ما تغطيه من الاقتصاد. فجي كام وإيميج نماذج توازن جزئي لأسواق الطاقة والأرض، بينما تمثل إيم هب وريمايند وويتش الاقتصاد كله. والثالث هو طريقة الحل. فنموذج مسج يقلل التكلفة الكلية للنظام ببرنامج خطي كبير. وريمايند يعظّم الرفاه على مدى القرن. وويتش يجعل المناطق تلعب لعبة ضد بعضها. وإيميج يحاكي الأرض والبيئة على شبكة دقيقة. ودايس، أبسطها، يوازن تكلفة خفض الانبعاثات مقابل الضرر الذي يُتجنب. وهذه الخيارات تشكّل النتائج. فنماذج الاستشراف تميل إلى التحرك مبكرًا وبسلاسة، مع ارتفاع أسعار الكربون بمعدل الخصم. والنماذج التتابعية تستجيب فترة بعد فترة. وفي النقل، فإن وحدة إيدج تي في ريمايند فرع من نموذج النقل في جي كام. افتح أطلس النماذج لاستكشاف كل منها.

diagram.title: Seven models by solution concept
diagram.caption: Each model's place depends on foresight, economic scope and solution method. Select a model for its one-line profile.

nodes.label: GCAM
nodes.detail: Partial equilibrium, recursive dynamic, 5-year steps; logit choice; 32 energy-economy regions, 235 water basins. Open source.

nodes.label: IMAGE
nodes.detail: Recursive simulation framework: TIMER energy model, land on a grid, MAGNET agro-economy, earth-system modules.

nodes.label: AIM-Hub
nodes.detail: Recursive dynamic computable general equilibrium (formerly AIM/CGE), 1-year steps, solved as a mixed complementarity problem.

nodes.label: MESSAGEix-GLOBIOM
nodes.detail: Linear-programming energy model minimising discounted system cost with perfect foresight, linked to GLOBIOM (land) and MACRO.

nodes.label: REMIND-MAgPIE
nodes.detail: Intertemporal Ramsey growth model with energy detail, soft-linked to MAgPIE (land); EDGE-T transport is a fork of GCAM's.

nodes.label: WITCH
nodes.detail: Hybrid optimal-growth model: regions maximise welfare strategically (Nash) or in coalitions; endogenous technical change.

nodes.label: DICE
nodes.detail: One global region; optimal growth with a damage function; computes the social cost of carbon. Latest: DICE-2023.

nodes.label: Your question
nodes.detail: Myopic or foresight? Energy-land detail or whole economy? Optimal policy or a what-if? Choose the model to match.

sections.heading: Three choices that define a model
sections.html:
Foresight: recursive (myopic) models solve each period with today's information; intertemporal models optimise all periods together. Economic scope: partial equilibrium (energy, land, water markets, with GDP given) or general equilibrium (all markets, GDP responds). Solution method: market clearing, cost minimisation, welfare maximisation, simulation or a game.

ModelForesightScopeMethod
GCAMRecursivePartialMarket clearing

AIM-HubRecursiveGeneralCGE (MCP)

sections.heading: How each one solves
sections.html:
• GCAM: in each 5-year period, a solver adjusts prices until every market clears; technologies share markets by logit.
  • MESSAGEix: one linear programme picks all technologies in all periods to meet demand at least discounted cost; a constraint's shadow price is the carbon price.
  • REMIND: a social planner maximises discounted welfare; investment in energy competes with consumption.
  • IMAGE: simulates year by year; land demand is allocated to grid cells by suitability.
  • AIM-Hub: all goods and factor markets clear each year; policy cost shows up as GDP or consumption loss.
  • WITCH: each region optimises given the others' choices until no one wants to change (Nash equilibrium), or a coalition optimises jointly.
  • DICE: cuts until the marginal cost of abatement equals the social cost of carbon.

sections.heading: Structure shapes results
sections.html: Foresight models under a carbon budget tend to produce carbon prices that rise at about the discount rate (the Hotelling rule) and act early where it is cheap. Recursive models respond to the price path you give them. General-equilibrium models report GDP losses; partial-equilibrium models report the area under a cost curve. Logit models spread markets across technologies; pure LP models can switch abruptly unless constrained. When two models disagree, check these differences before blaming the data.

sections.heading: Transport across the family
sections.html: GCAM represents passenger and freight transport by mode, size class and technology with a value-of-time cost and logit choice (module 3.2). REMIND couples EDGE-T, which its developers describe as a fork of the GCAM transport module, run between REMIND iterations. MESSAGEix has a detailed MESSAGEix-Transport variant. IMAGE's TIMER model includes a passenger transport module. This shared ancestry is one reason transport results from GCAM and REMIND can be compared closely.

sections.heading: Choosing a model, or several
sections.html: Ask what your question needs. Policy what-ifs with rich energy-land-water detail and open code: GCAM. Least-cost pathways and investment timing: MESSAGEix or REMIND. Economy-wide costs and trade: AIM-Hub or another CGE. Strategic behaviour between regions: WITCH. The optimal carbon price: DICE. For a robust finding, use a model comparison with harmonised inputs, as in the EMF and IPCC exercises.

callouts.title: Check before you cite
callouts.html: Model versions change. Confirm features in the IAMC documentation wiki and each model's own documentation for the version you cite; the course's ratings are teaching simplifications.

callouts.title: Common trap
callouts.html: "Model A says $200 per tonne, model B $80, so one is wrong." A GDP-loss cost and an area-under-curve cost are different measures, and foresight changes the timing. Compare like with like.

callouts.title: Research idea
callouts.html: Run the same transport policy (say, a ZEV standard) in GCAM and compare with published REMIND-EDGE-T results: where do the logit settings and value of time explain the gap?

glossary.def: Solving one period at a time using only current information (myopic).
Choosing all periods together, knowing future prices and policies.
A model in which all markets in the economy, including labour and capital, clear together.
On a least-cost path under a fixed budget, the carbon price rises at the discount rate.
A set of choices where no player gains by changing its own choice alone.
The present value of damages from emitting one more tonne of CO2.
